AgentPath.description:
Canonical logical address of one node inside a Primary Session Agent tree.

This type owns path parsing and ancestry rules. Session IDs remain the durable execution identity and must not be inferred from this path.

AgentTreeNode.description: One Agent tree node and its direct child nodes.

AgentTreeSnapshot.description: One recursively nested Agent tree projected from durable child Sessions.

AgentTurnRef.description: Exact Session Turn identity constructed by a trusted application adapter.

ApiError.description:
Public application error object shared by server and SDKs.

`message` is an English fallback derived from `code`. Clients must branch on `code` and apply localization outside the backend.

CollaborationToolResult.description:
Canonical strongly typed result emitted by collaboration Tools.

Generic Tool transport may serialize this enum once, but business and presentation consumers must decode this tagged contract rather than select a result shape from the Tool name.

ContextCompactionMetrics.description: Public metrics for a context compaction maintenance item.

ContextCompactionOutcome.description: Terminal result of a context compaction maintenance item.

ContextCompactionStage.description: Current stage of a context compaction timeline item.

ContextCompactionTrigger.description: Reason a run entered the context compaction maintenance stage.

ContextUsage.description: Last successfully measured model-context usage for a Session.

DynamicToolResult.description: Result submitted by an external Dynamic Tool consumer.

DynamicToolResultParams.description: Parameters for an existing Dynamic Tool result request.

ErrorCode.description:
Public application error code shared by server and SDKs.

This enum is the single source of truth for client-visible application error semantics. Transport adapters may map codes to protocol-specific envelopes or status codes, but they must not add new application semantics.

FileDeleteRequest.description: Selects one file to delete for the authenticated user.

FileDeleteResponse.description: Confirms the identifier of a deleted file.

FileInfo.description: Public metadata for one authenticated user's ready file.

FileListRequest.description: Filters one authenticated user's files with opaque cursor pagination.

FileListResponse.description: Returns one page of ready files and the next opaque cursor.

FileReadRequest.description: Selects one file owned by the authenticated user.

FileReadResponse.description: Returns public metadata for one ready file.

FileScope.description: Selects whether a file is personal or restricted to one project context.

FileUpdateRequest.description: Replaces selected mutable metadata on one ready file.

FileUpdateResponse.description: Returns public metadata after a successful file update.

FileUploadParams.description: App Server upload envelope; other file methods use shared request objects directly.

FileUploadRequest.description: Describes metadata supplied alongside one streamed file upload.

FileUploadResponse.description: Returns the ready file created by an upload.

MessageQueue.description: The complete bounded message queue visible to clients for one session.

MessageQueueAddRequest.description: Parameters for adding one message to a Session queue.

MessageQueueChangedNotification.description: Live invalidation signal emitted after a visible queue mutation.

MessageQueueDeleteRequest.description: Parameters for deleting one waiting message.

MessageQueueListRequest.description: Parameters for reading one complete Session queue.

MessageQueueReorderRequest.description: Parameters for applying a complete queue permutation.

MessageQueueStartRequest.description: Parameters for starting the queue head or one selected message.

MessageQueueSteerRequest.description: Parameters for steering one waiting message into an exact active Turn.

MessageQueueUpdateRequest.description: Parameters for replacing one waiting message.

ModelRef.description: Identifies a concrete model under a provider for request-time selection.

ModelSelection.description: Selects a model and the reasoning policy applied to requests using it.

PendingUserAction.description: Current user action exposed across Service, protocol, SDK, and client boundaries.

ProfileDailyUsage.description: Represents finalized usage attributed to one calendar day.

ProfileModelUsage.description: Represents finalized usage grouped by its recorded model.

ProfileReadRequest.description: Requests the authenticated user's Profile usage summary.

ProfileReadResponse.description:
Returns the authenticated user's current resource counts and historical usage.

Gateway, SDK, and UI boundaries share this DTO. It does not expose database records or support querying another user's data.

protocol.description: Wire protocol used for this provider.

QuestionAnswer.description: Selected or free-form answer to a semantic question.

QuestionOption.description: One mutually exclusive answer offered by a semantic question.

QuestionParams.description: Model-authored semantic question shown to the user.

QueuedMessage.description: A user message waiting in a session-scoped in-memory queue.

SandboxApprovalDecision.description: Fixed decision accepted for a sandbox approval.

SandboxApprovalParams.description: Server-authored sandbox approval presented to the user.

SandboxApprovalPresentation.description: Bounded user-facing facts for the requested sandbox capability.

SandboxApprovalReason.description: Stable reason category for a sandbox approval.

SandboxFileOperation.description: Filesystem operation displayed by a sandbox approval.

SendMessageResult.description: Accepted message delivery to one exact running child Turn.

SessionConf.description: Configuration override stored with a session.

SessionHistoryMessage.description: Stable message view for session history.

SessionHistorySnapshot.description: Stable session history snapshot. This is not a replay cursor envelope.

SessionUsage.description: Session-owned usage combining cumulative token accounting with the latest context snapshot.

StartTurnRequest.description: Request payload used by clients to start a turn in a session.

modelSelection.description: Explicit model selection for this turn; absent means use the session or configured default.

userPermissionMode.description: Permission override used only when this request creates a missing session.

SubagentOutcome.description: Current state projected from the child Session's existing Turn facts.

SubagentRef.description: Stable handle for a child Session and its immutable owner.

SubagentSnapshot.description: Durable child identity paired with its projected execution state.

SubagentSpawnResult.description: Exact durable child identity and the initial Turn accepted for execution.

SubagentUpdate.description: Latest bounded assistant activity for the current child Turn.

SubagentUpdateKind.description: Kind of bounded assistant activity exposed by a Subagent snapshot.

SubmitUserActionRequest.description: Request accepted by the application service to answer one pending user action.

SubmitUserActionResponse.description: Current durable state returned after a user-action response is submitted.

TalosConnectionMode.description: Talos gateway protocol types shared by server and client components.

TalosContentItem.description: Talos content item for rich output blocks.

TalosTimelineContent.description: Current full content for a timeline item.

TalosTimelineDelta.description: Incremental update for an existing timeline item.

TalosTimelineItemKind.description: Timeline item kind rendered by clients.

TalosTimelinePhase.description: Server-normalized display-layer union of model, assistant, and kernel execution phases.

TimelineUserActionEvent.description: Durable Timeline projection for a requested or finished user action.

TokenUsage.description: Token usage values shared by runs, sessions, history, and metrics.

TurnExecutionMetrics.description: Kernel-owned execution metrics for a turn.

UserActionParams.description: Typed parameters needed to render and resume a user action.

UserActionResponse.description: Typed response accepted by the user-action service.

UserActionState.description: Durable lifecycle state of a user action.

UserPermissionMode.description: Product permission mode selected for a Session.
